name: WebGL Path Tracing Volume Rendering
aliases: Interactive Voxel Volume Rendering via WebGL 2.0
definition: An interactive voxel volume renderer using path tracing that runs in modern browsers via WebGL 2.0. It renders 3D scalar fields (volumes) by casting rays from the camera through the volume, accumulating color and opacity along the ray, and applying lighting/shadowing.
summary: WebGL Path Tracing Volume Rendering is an interactive browser-based renderer that distinguishes itself by implementing path-tracing-like shading with diffuse, specular, and soft shadows within the fragment shader.
